## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration (14/4)

## Definitions

- [statement] A cursor is not safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines, even though a Go Context is safe to share between goroutines. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://pkg.go.dev/context, https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go

## How it works

- [statement] A deadline on the operation context overrides the client timeout; without a context deadline, operations can inherit the client Timeout setting. Call the cancel function when timed work finishes to release context resources. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/context.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/connect/connection-options/csot.md, https://pkg.go.dev/context
- [statement] The Go driver uses contexts to signal timeout and cancellation for blocking calls. Derive an operation context with context.WithTimeout and call its cancel function when the operation finishes to release resources. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/context.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://pkg.go.dev/context
- [statement] Close a cursor when it is no longer needed, including when individual iteration ends early. The driver Close method is idempotent, and Next and TryNext must not be called afterwards. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Create a context deadline for the intended iteration budget. Reusing the same WithTimeout context across Next calls keeps one absolute deadline; it does not grant a fresh interval on every call. For a separate per-call budget, derive a fresh context for each call and cancel it afterwards. (high confidence) — https://pkg.go.dev/context · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/connect/connection-options/csot.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Consume a cursor with Next, decode each document, check Err after the loop, and close the cursor when finished; false from Next alone does not distinguish exhaustion from an iteration error. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go
- [statement] TryNext is intended for tailable cursors. A false result can mean that no document is available yet; retry only if Err is nil and ID is nonzero. An error or exhausted cursor makes further attempts return false. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Treat the guide description of TryNext as non-blocking as a limited distinction from Next: the inspected implementation still calls the underlying batch cursor when the local batch is exhausted, then returns on an empty live batch instead of looping. It is not a guarantee that the call performs no network wait. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go
- [statement] The timeout passed to All covers retrieval across its batch loop rather than resetting for each document. The implementation defers Close with context.Background so cleanup can run even when the All context has failed. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/connect/connection-options/csot.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go

## Facts and statements

- [statement] All populates a slice with the remaining results and closes the cursor after retrieval. Prefer iterative consumption for results that may exceed available application memory. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go
- [statement] The v2 migration removes granular timeout APIs including FindOptions.SetMaxTime and ClientOptions.SetSocketTimeout. Use a client operation timeout or a deadline on the operation context instead; an independent migration account describes the same replacement. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/docs/migration-2.0.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://p.umputun.com/en/2026/02/21/mongodb-go-driver-v2/
- [statement] In the inspected cursor implementation, the local-batch fast path returns a buffered document before calling the underlying batch cursor with the context. Therefore context deadlines bound blocking fetch work and should not be described as forcibly interrupting every locally buffered iteration or application-side processing step. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-go-driver/blob/master/mongo/cursor.go · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/context.md, https://pkg.go.dev/context
- [statement] A Stack Overflow answer equates closing a canceled operation connection with returning it idle to the pool. MongoDB documentation instead states that the cancellation listener closes the connection and returns context.Canceled. These positions should remain attributed; the forum answer is not sufficient evidence of pool reuse or server-operation termination. (medium confidence) — https://stackoverflow.com/questions/70779021/does-cancelling-the-context-for-a-query-using-the-mongodb-go-driver-affect-runni · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/context.md
- [statement] Timeouts can be consumed before server execution: the driver checks context expiration during server selection and connection checkout, and uses the shorter of the context deadline and connection timeout for connection establishment. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/context.md · keywords: Go driver context timeouts and cursor iteration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/go/current/connect/connection-options/csot.md
